name: In the News
description: Links a current event to the syllabus: the headline fact, what happened, why it happened, the concept it illustrates, and a discussion. Dates and figures are flagged for checking.
audience: Current affairs, economics, civics, geography and science-in-the-news lessons.

signals.why: your words are about current events

slides.guidance: A headline-style title for {topic}, with a subtitle linking it to the chapter.
The key fact of the news story. Write [verify] for any number or date not in the source.
What happened, in three or four plain points.
The causes of the event and its likely effects.
The syllabus concept this news illustrates, and how.
Questions about what should happen next and who is affected.

variants.guidance: A classroom meme about {topic}. Pick one format from MEME FORMATS that matches the idea, write captions a {grade} student finds funny and that make the correct idea easier to remember. Kind to students, never about a person.

slides.guidance: A question that checks the concept, not the news trivia.
The concept in one line, and how to spot it in the news again.
